description: This file contains unit tests for the DrugOrder class in the OpenMRS project, utilizing JUnit 5 and Mockito to verify behavior of drug order cloning, copying, comparison, dosing instructions, and auto-expire date calculations.

classes.name: DrugOrderTest
classes.description: A test suite for the DrugOrder class, verifying cloning, copying, comparison logic, dosing instructions, and expiration date behaviors.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Tests that cloning a DrugOrder for discontinuation appropriately sets all relevant fields.

methods.name: copy_shouldCopyAllDrugOrderFields
methods.description: Verifies that the copy method duplicates all fields from the original DrugOrder.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Checks that cloning a DrugOrder for revision copies all relevant fields correctly.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetTheRelevantFieldsForADCOrder
methods.description: Ensures that cloneForRevision correctly resets certain fields such as autoExpireDate, dateStopped, and accessionNumber.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheOtherOrderIsNull
methods.description: Tests that hasSameOrderableAs returns false when the other order is null.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheOtherOrderIsNotADrugOrder
methods.description: Verifies that hasSameOrderableAs returns false if the other order is not a DrugOrder.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfBothDrugsAreNullAndTheConceptsAreDifferent
methods.description: Checks that the method returns false when concepts differ and no drugs are set.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptsMatchAndOnlyThisHasADrug
methods.description: Verifies that the method returns false if only the original order has a drug, despite matching concepts.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptsMatchAndOnlyTheOtherHasADrug
methods.description: Verifies that the method returns false if only the other order has a drug, despite matching concepts.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptsMatchAndDrugsAreDifferentAndNotNull
methods.description: Ensures the comparison returns false when both have drugs but they are different.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfBothDrugsAreNullAndTheConceptsMatch
methods.description: Checks that the method returns true when concepts match and neither order has a drug.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfTheDrugsMatch
methods.description: Verifies that the method returns true when both orders have the same drug.

methods.name: shouldSetDefaultDosingTypeToFreeText
methods.description: Ensures that a new DrugOrder defaults its dosing type to SimpleDosingInstructions.

methods.name: shouldAllowToSetCustomDosingTypes
methods.description: Tests that a custom dosing instructions type can be assigned and retrieved.

methods.name: setAutoExpireDateBasedOnDuration_shouldDelegateCalculationToDosingInstructions
methods.description: Verifies that the auto-expire date is calculated via the DosingInstructions dependency.

methods.name: setAutoExpireDateBasedOnDuration_shouldNotCalculateForDiscontinueAction
methods.description: Ensures that auto expiration date calculation is skipped if the action is DISCONTINUE.

methods.name: setAutoExpireDateBasedOnDuration_shouldNotCalculateIfAutoExpireDateAlreadySet
methods.description: Checks that if the autoExpireDate is already set, it does not get recalculated.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfTheConceptsMatchAndHaveSameDrugNonCoded
methods.description: Validates that the comparison considers non-coded drug names and matches them regardless of case or whitespace.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptsMatchAndHaveDifferentDrugNonCoded
methods.description: Checks that differences in drugNonCoded strings lead to a false result.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfTheConceptsMatchAndHaveSameDrugNonCodedTrimmingSpaces
methods.description: Verifies that whitespace trimming makes equivalent non-coded drugs be considered equal.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptsMatchAndEitherOfDrugNonCodedIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that if one order's non-coded drug is null, comparison returns false.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfTheConceptsMatchAndBothDrugNonCodedIsNull
methods.description: Checks that orders with null non-coded drugs and matching concepts are considered the same.
